description: The line plot illustrates the perplexity of four different models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, Vicuna-7B, and a fourth model represented by the green line—across varying values of M, which ranges from 3 to 8 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Perplexity," is also on a linear scale and spans from approximately 18 to 42. The green line, corresponding to LLaMA1-7B, starts at a perplexity of about 28 when M=3, decreases to around 24 at M=5, then increases to approximately 36 at M=8. The orange line, representing LLaMA1-13B, begins at a perplexity of about 20 when M=3, decreases to roughly 17 at M=5, and then rises to about 20 at M=8. The blue line, corresponding to Vicuna-7B, starts at a perplexity of approximately 41 when M=3, decreases to around 34 at M=5, and then increases to about 39 at M=8. The green line, which is not explicitly labeled in the legend, starts at a perplexity of about 28 when M=3, decreases to around 24 at M=5, and then increases to approximately 36 at M=8. All lines show a general trend of decreasing perplexity from M=3 to M=5, followed by an increase from M=5 to M=8.
